name: 3124-twocount-ruling-03-two-names-in-one-kind-one-name-groups-in-another-load
models:
module core
version 0.1.0
distribution public
source "probe"
key uid string -
key time_ms int ms
module probe
version 0.1.0
distribution public
source "probe"
key x int -
key y int -
key z int -
key val int -
key qty int -
list nums "a list"
list recs "a list"
list items "a list"
list subs "a list"
pack:
format probe
version 0.31.0
distribution public
source "probe"
uses probe
wire bits
layout sequential
count a 8
count b 8 plus 1
kind k1
when 8 1
group probe.nums count @a @b
  field probe.val 8 uint
end
kind k2
when 8 2
group probe.nums count @a
  field probe.val 8 uint
end
group probe.recs count @b
  field probe.x 8 uint
end
